name: Vaibhav Kadia
bio: Vaibhav Kadia has experience of two decades in higher education. He is Assistant Professor at Amrut Mody School of Management, Ahmedabad University. He graduated from H. L. College of Commerce, Ahmedabad and did post-graduation and M Phil from Gujarat University. He had done PhD from Ganpat University on the topic of "An in-depth study of Passenger Satisfaction of BRTS for Gujarat State". He has been teaching courses on Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting and Corporate Accounting.
